relations.subject: Maurice Bloomfield
relations.evidence: He went to the United States in 1867, and 10 years later graduated from Furman University, Greenville, South Carolina.

relations.subject: Maurice Bloomfield
relations.evidence: He then studied Sanskrit at Yale, under W. D. Whitney, and at Johns Hopkins University.

relations.subject: Maurice Bloomfield
relations.evidence: He was part of the second graduating class to earn a PhD from Johns Hopkins; his degree was conferred in 1879.

relations.subject: Maurice Bloomfield
relations.evidence: He returned to Hopkins as associate professor in 1881

relations.subject: Maurice Bloomfield
relations.role: professor of Sanskrit and comparative philology
relations.evidence: soon afterwards was promoted professor of Sanskrit and comparative philology. He was forced by ill health to retire in 1926 and was named Professor Emeritus in honor of his 45 years on the Hopkins faculty.
